edition_angle: Evaluating emerging physiological mechanisms and non-pharmacological influences on central nervous system function and recovery.

assignments.angle: Investigating how unrecovered physical strain disrupts striatal dopamine neurochemistry, offering insights into sleep disturbance, mood regulation, and recovery balance in active adults.
assignments.reason: This finding highlights a distinct neurological link between physical overtraining and altered central neurotransmitter levels, providing actionable, evidence-based context for balancing physical exertion and nervous system recovery in healthspan management.
